name: Master Services Agreement Playbook
description: Firm standard for MSA / Professional Services agreements.

red_flags: broad IP indemnity with no carve-outs

ip_ownership.acceptable: customer owns bespoke deliverables; supplier retains background IP and tools

standard_clauses.limitation_of_liability: Neither party shall be liable for any indirect, special, incidental or consequential losses. Each party's total aggregate liability shall not exceed the total fees paid or payable in the twelve months prior to the claim.
standard_clauses.indemnity: Each party shall indemnify the other against direct losses arising from its breach of this Agreement, limited to the liability cap set out herein.
